Have you ever noticed how, in the most ordinary moments, there’s often something unspoken guiding the way we interact? It’s almost like there’s a secret script running beneath the surface—one that shapes how we connect, compete, or even just make small talk.
Now, imagine having a backstage pass to all of this. That’s exactly what we get as we dive into the world of Games People Play by Eric Berne. Together, we’ll unravel the fascinating patterns and quiet rules that shape our relationships—at home, at work, and everywhere in between. Berne invites us to look past the obvious, and discover the psychological “games” we all play, often without even realizing it.
Through the lens of transactional analysis, we’ll explore how people adopt roles, follow invisible scripts, and seek out validation, power, or closeness in ways that aren’t always clear on the surface. Each conversation becomes a clue, each reaction a chance to see what’s really driving us—and those around us.
As we peel back these layers together, we’ll start to see how understanding these hidden games can help us break free from old patterns and build more genuine, fulfilling connections. So, if you’re curious about what really goes on beneath the surface of everyday life, and you’re ready to discover new ways to grow and relate, you’re in the right place. Let’s explore this journey of self-awareness and transformation—side by side.
